title: Self-claimed is a label, not an insult.
hook: 125-plus projects, claimed by the business. Not independently verified. Saying so is the trust move.
thesis: HPP's proof claims carry their verification status explicitly. When the business says 125-plus projects, the graph labels it self-claimed: claimed by the business, not independently verified. The label is not an insult; it is the mechanism that lets a visitor know exactly what is vouched for and by whom. This post teaches proof-claim labeling as a content practice any business can adopt.

verified: Proof claims are explicitly labeled as self-claimed rather than independently verified (graph data doc, via SYSTEMS.md section 5).
Conflicts between sources are recorded with precedence decisions, not silently resolved (graph data doc).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
